title: PLDT internet services fully restored after cable cut

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — PLDT said its internet services were fully restored nationwide Sunday afternoon following a service disruption caused by a submarine cable cut between the Philippines and Singapore. In an advisory, PLDT said services returned to normal at 4:30 p.m. “Services have fully normalized nationwide following the submarine cable cut between the Philippines and Singapore on Oct. 2,” the company said. READ: Internet outages hit parts of PH as undersea cable goes offline PLDT had earlier advised customers that the cable cut was affecting internet services nationwide.
